name: Madryn al Cubo 2022

venue.name: Bajada 9 - Parador Municipal
venue.address: Bv. Almte Brown 3049, Puerto Madryn, Chubut

information:
"Madryn al Cubo 2022" contará con **7 categorias** (3x3 - 4x4 - 5x5 - 2x2 - Pyraminx - One Hand - Megaminx) y **11 rondas** en total. El objetivo es que los competidores de la region puedan actualizar sus tiempos y seguir mejorando. Contamos con la experiencia de haber organizado el [Patagonia Open 2019](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PatagoniaOpen2019)  y el [Argentina ReOpen 2021](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ArgentinaReOpen2021) con gran éxito. El cupo maximo de competidores será de 25, con **1 acompañante como maximo** (padre, madre, hermano, tutor, amigo, etc) pudiendose anotar a todas las categorias que deseen pagando 1 sola inscripcion. **Se ruega puntualidad**. Recomendamos llegar 15 minutos antes de cada ronda en la que vas a competir.

*ENGLISH*
"Madryn al Cubo 2022" will feature **7 categories** (3x3 - 4x4 - 5x5 - 2x2 - Pyraminx - One Hand - Megaminx) and **11 rounds** in total. The objective is that the competitors in the region can update their times and continue to improve. We have the experience of having organized [Patagonia Open 2019](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PatagoniaOpen2019) and [Argentina ReOpen 2021](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ArgentinaReOpen2021) with great success. The maximum capacity of competitors will be 25, with a **maximum of 1 companion** (father, mother, brother, guardian, friend, etc.) being able to enter all the categories that they wish by paying only 1 registration. **Punctuality is necessary**. We recommend arriving 15 minutes before each round in which you are going to compete.
